clips.yt_title: One Agent, Seven Teams, Zero Employees! #Shorts
clips.ig_caption:
One agent. Seven AI teams. Zero employees. That’s not a metaphor—it’s an org chart. Here’s how a single agent can support seven teams—without hiring a single person. 🤖

The orchestrator never does the work. It routes, reviews, and fires. Seven specialists execute: research, content, design, code, distribution, analytics, QA.

You stop prompting. You start managing. Output multiplies; your hours stay flat.

Build the org chart once. Let it compound while you sleep.

Save this. Then go build the layer. 🔁
